High-Protein Smoky Chicken Sandwich

A juicy, high-protein chicken sandwich made in an air fryer. The chicken filling can be meal-prepped for several days and assembled fresh.

Ingredients

Chicken batch — 9 sandwiches

- 1 kg raw chicken breast
- 1 tsp salt
- 1 tsp MSG
- 2 tsp paprika
- 2 tsp garlic powder
- 1 tsp black pepper
- 1 tsp chilli flakes (optional)
- 2 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tsp oil (optional)

Chicken filling

After cooking the chicken, combine the batch with:

- 240 g Skyr high-protein plain yogurt
- 140 g salsa
- Additional garlic powder, paprika, chilli flakes and black pepper to taste

Per sandwich

- 111 g raw-chicken equivalent from the prepared filling
- 26.7 g Skyr
- ~16 g Mexican salsa
- 2 slices sourdough bread (~94 g total)
- 2 Amul cheese slices
- 2 small iceberg lettuce leaves
- 6 pickled jalapeño slices

---

1. Prepare the chicken

Cut the 1 kg chicken breast into small, roughly equal-sized pieces. Smaller pieces cook faster and are easier to use in sandwiches.

Add:

- Salt
- Paprika
- Garlic powder
- Black pepper
- Chilli flakes
- Soy sauce
- A little oil if using

Mix thoroughly until every piece is coated.

Marinate for 20–30 minutes. You can also refrigerate it overnight.

2. Air-fry the chicken

Preheat the air fryer to 190°C.

Spread the chicken out in the basket. Avoid packing it into a huge pile; cook in batches if necessary.

Air fry for approximately:

190°C → 10 minutes

Then shake/flip the chicken and cook for another:
190°C → 5–7 minutes
Cooking time depends on the size of the pieces.
The chicken should reach 74°C internally.
Don't overcook it. Chicken breast gets dry very quickly.
Let the cooked chicken rest for 5–10 minutes.
Save any juices released during cooking and mix them back into the chicken.

3. Make the chicken filling

Once the chicken has cooled slightly, chop it into smaller pieces if necessary.

For the full 1 kg batch, mix:

- 240 g Skyr
- 140 g salsa
- Garlic powder
- Paprika
- Chilli flakes
- Black pepper

Add the cooked chicken and mix until everything is evenly coated.

The goal is a creamy coating, not a pool of sauce.

For meal prep, divide the finished filling into 9 equal portions.

Each portion corresponds to approximately:

- 111 g raw chicken
- 26.7 g Skyr
- 16 g salsa

This makes tracking much easier because you don't need to weigh the cooked chicken.

4. Assemble one sandwich

Take:

1. 2 slices sourdough bread
2. Add 2 Amul cheese slices
3. Add one portion of chicken filling
4. Add iceberg lettuce
5. Add 6 pickled jalapeño slices
6. Close with the second slice of bread

The cheese helps create a barrier between the moist filling and the bread, which reduces sogginess.

5. Toast

Air fryer

Place the assembled sandwich in the air fryer.

180°C for 3–4 minutes

Cook until:

- The bread is crisp
- The cheese is melted
- The filling is hot

If the bread is browning too quickly, reduce the temperature slightly.

Microwave option

If you only have a microwave:

- Place the sandwich on a microwave-safe plate.
- Microwave on high for ~60 seconds.
- Check the center.
- Add another 20–30 seconds if necessary.

The microwave will make the bread softer. Air frying is much better for texture.

---

Meal Prep & Storage

For a multi-day batch, ideally store:

- Chicken filling → airtight container in the refrigerator
- Bread → separate
- Cheese → separate
- Lettuce/jalapeños → separate

Assemble sandwiches when needed.

If taking one to work, keep it refrigerated or in an insulated lunch bag with an ice pack until eating.

Approximate nutrition per sandwich

Using the ingredients in the tracked meal:

- ~498 kcal
- ~45–50 g protein
- High fiber from the sourdough/vegetables
- High protein from chicken, Skyr and cheese

The exact nutrition will depend on the specific cheese, Skyr, salsa and bread brands.

The basic formula
Air-fried seasoned chicken + Skyr/salsa filling + sourdough + double cheese + lettuce + jalapeño → air fryer → crispy, cheesy chicken sandwich.

🚨 IF YOU HOLD CRYPTO ON AN IPHONE, READ THIS.

Hackers have found a new way to steal crypto from iPhone users without downloading anything.

A hacking campaign called MoldyRoost is targeting vulnerable iPhones running iOS 13-17.2.1 and iOS 18.4-18.7 through malicious ads.

Just visiting a malicious webpage could put your crypto wallet seed phrases at risk.

The malware searches your notes, photos, passwords, and wallet data, including information linked to MetaMask, Phantom, and Trust Wallet.

Imagine surviving years of market crashes, only to lose everything because of one wrong click.

Update your iPhone to the latest iOS version and NEVER store seed phrases in screenshots or notes.

Our portfolios are already down so much but don't let hackers take whatever is left.

$NVDA - TRUMP OPEN TO PARDONING JENSEN HUANG, CONSIDERS U.S. STAKE IN NVIDIA

President Donald Trump told the New York Post he would consider granting Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang a presidential pardon if necessary, although he doubts one will be needed.

“It’s always an option, I guess, but I don’t think it’ll be necessary,” Trump said.

Trump also urged Huang to testify truthfully before Congress next week, suggesting he would not need to invoke the Fifth Amendment.

Separately, Trump said a U.S. government equity stake in Nvidia remains a possibility, adding that it is “probably not too late.”
